title: Three visible authority states
claim_boundary: A score may route only within the deterministic authority ceiling.

states.name: 1  Suggest
states.detail: Show evidence and recommendation. A human decides.

states.name: 2  Propose + positive acknowledgement
states.detail: An authorized person approves this exact, unexpired proposal.

states.name: 3  Eligible for bounded automated execution
states.detail: A separately approved class may reach the executor after recheck.
